'''Asteria''' was a minor [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The criminal operated from a fortified [[Asteria's townhouse|townhouse]]. Soon after being exiled from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Snoova]] worked as an indentured [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] for her. After Snoova served the length of his contract, Asteria released [[Gender/Legends|him]] from service.
